summary: Published one canonical count set for the 77-product catalog, added a regression test that ties README, skills index and generated site counts to their canonical sources, corrected the stale PLAN.md status, and fixed the same Node 22 test-discovery bug in all 16 product workspaces.

commands.command: for f in products/*/*/package.json; do (cd $(dirname $f) && npm test); done

decisions: Catalog identity and scope are canonical in catalog/products.jsonl plus catalog/manifests/faang.json; the open-source landscape is canonical in tools/skills/catalog-data.mjs.
README and PLAN numbers are guarded by a test instead of being generated, because README is hand-edited prose.
Workspace test scripts now pass tests/*.test.mjs explicitly, matching the root fix for Node 22.
risks: catalog/products.jsonl still records alternative_status none_verified for all 77 products while the skills landscape records 40 available / 29 partial / 8 pending; gaps alternatives therefore lists all 77.

The site generator still emits canonical/OG URLs for rae-faang-landing.vercel.app while the Pages workflow and README use enzovezzaro.github.io/rea-faang; changing the canonical domain is an SEO decision left to the maintainer.
recommendedNextAction: Review the count-consistency test, then align catalog/products.jsonl alternative_status with catalog-data.mjs in a separate evidenced change.
